think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s documented type, units, and valid range. 2) Check whether any in-range numeric value is documented to trigger a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/enable/auto/infinite), typically via sentinel values like -1 or 0. 3) If such a sentinel exists and changes behavior beyond simple magnitude tuning, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). 4) Otherwise, classify as not special.
